class TermType(Enum):
    """Denotes the type of interaction of a Fermionic operator."""

    NUMBER = 1
    EXCITATION = 2
    DOUBLE_EXCITATION = 3
    NUMBER_EXCITATION = 4
    COULOMB_EXCHANGE = 5
